title: SciLifeLab Training Webpage Template User Guide
description:
A step-by-step guide to the SciLifeLab Training Webpage Template, for trainers with no experience of Git, Python or Quarto. It explains how to set up, publish and maintain a FAIR website for a training: the landing page, training instances, data files, training materials, instructor notes, and publishing the training on Zenodo.

Read the guide: https://scilifelab-training.github.io/scilifelab-training-template-user-guide/
